purpose: Post-selection descriptive replay of the mechanically selected 180-day member-history decay candidate on the exact frozen 24-case 2025-2026 House holdout through the unchanged historical Quick analogue, roster, and chamber pipeline. This replay cannot promote the candidate to production.

replayPolicy.quickAnaloguePipeline: unchanged historical Quick analogue selection and weighting
replayPolicy.chamberAggregation: unchanged ordinary Minnesota passage rule and chamber simulation
replayPolicy.caseSelection: exact frozen 24 holdout cases; no replacement or reranking
replayPolicy.baseline: immutable uncapped/unweighted Quick probabilities and outcomes from the one-shot #176 holdout artifact

reportedMetrics: case-level signed residual and expected-Yes error

interpretation.primaryQuestion: Does the mechanically selected 180-day member-history decay candidate retain its component-level gains when replayed through the exact already-revealed Quick holdout pipeline?
interpretation.notConfirmatory: The 2025-2026 outcomes contributed to the retrospective decay screen and were already revealed before this replay. Any improvement is post-selection descriptive evidence only.
interpretation.promotionBoundary: No outcome of this replay may change MEMBER_MODEL_VERSION, runtime history weighting, production probabilities, the frozen cap-20 prospective experiment, Deep targeting, or Journal mechanics. Any decay promotion requires a separately frozen future prospective/shadow validation lineage.
